MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The portable Bluetooth mouse fits my repeated mouse purchases and recent wireless keyboard purchase, so it feels like a practical addition to my computer setup.",
    "The Echo Show 15 connects naturally with my recent Echo Show, Echo Dot, and Fire TV purchases because it offers familiar functions on a larger screen for another room."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The iPad protector, Galaxy Buds case, Arlo chime, and Galaxy SmartTag depend on specific devices or setups that my history does not establish I own.",
    "The iPad Air, separate MP3 player, and earbuds do not address a clear current need; my recent purchases point more toward computer peripherals and expanding my Alexa setup.",
    "The Echo Show 10 fits my interests, but having recently bought a Show 5 and its stand, I would explore the larger Show 15 before choosing another similar display."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying Bluetooth devices does not mean I want every Bluetooth product; a mouse serves a recurring need for me, while a tracker or music player serves a different purpose.",
    "My purchases of accessories and a home security alarm do not establish ownership of the particular iPad, Galaxy Buds, or Arlo devices needed by these recommendations."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Show 5 stand purchase suggests I am actively using that display, so another display needs a clear additional purpose to appeal to me.",
    "My repeated peripheral purchases and recent multi-device keyboard make practical computer accessories more relevant than unrelated electronics.",
    "Compatibility matters: my replacement remote batteries and Show 5 stand had specific connections to devices in my history, unlike several suggested accessories."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in Alexa devices and computer peripherals, but stretched that interest into products without a clear use or compatible device in my history."
}
